description: Add an A/B arm to a step. A lead is FIXED to one arm at enrolment and never switches mid-thread, which is what makes the result readable. 🔴 An empty subject_template means CONTINUE THE THREAD — leave it empty on follow-up steps rather than inventing one. Requires draft or paused.

subject_template.description: Empty = stay in the thread (Subject header omitted). Non-empty = start a new thread. Merge tags allowed, but NOT {{unsub_url}} — an unsubscribe URL in a subject line is a deliverability incident.

workspace.description: Tenant to target (cli_…). Omit to use the active/bound workspace. list_workspaces shows the options.
